phase_name: Write status: "partial" on a blocker-bearing partial outcome

objectives.description: Split partial)/failed|blocked) arms and add gated status write
Add cross-reference comments in both scripts
Add missing partial) case arm to skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh (deviation: required for the write to function)

deviations.description: skill_postflight_update's own case switch (scripts/skill-base.sh) has no `partial)` arm; calling it with status="partial" silently no-ops (falls into the `*)` default "Non-success status" skip). The write cannot function without adding a `partial)` arm there.
deviations.reason: Discovered at implementation time via direct read of skill-base.sh; not listed in the plan's Phase 1 Files to modify, but required for deliverable point 1 to work at all.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — widened scope to scripts/skill-base.sh, required for the status write to actually execute)*
